text:
Nora: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands infra update  putting questions here so leads can answer async.
Nora: Main asks: blackout / supply windows, prewarm strategy for 5-90s bursts, Dedicated SLA credit when we failover regions.
Ethan: Short answers: blackout windows come from supply/vendor ship dates. We're planning maintenance windows for region swaps; exact dates will be published once vendor confirms.
Vik: For short bursts we keep seeing full model loads. Are we doing anything besides warm pools?
Ethan: Yes  adding a lightweight hot-pool + fast-swap layer. Hot-pool holds minimal KV and tokenized model artifacts so we can service ~60s spikes without full model mmap.
Sam: How will the hot-pool behave under sustained fire? risk of token exhaustion?
Ethan: Hot-pool is bounded and complemented by a prioritization queue. Short spikes (<60s) drain from hot-pool tokens; sustained load triggers normal scaler path. We'll publish knobs.
Nora: Can we get the autoscaler sample config and the debug kubectl?
Vik: Example autoscaler snippet:
```yaml
autoscaler:
  min_replicas: 3
  max_replicas: 150
  hot_pool:
    enabled: true
    size_percent: 12
    token_capacity: 40
    token_refill_per_min: 8
  transient_ttl: 60s
```
Vik: Quick `kubectl` to list hot pods:
```bash
kubectl -n runtime get pods -l redwood.hot=true -o wide
```
infra-bot: New runbook uploaded: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/infra/hot-pool-and-blackout (internal).
Sam: For Dedicated customers, if we failover regionally due to supply blackouts, will there be SLA credits or automatic fallbacks?
Ethan: Policy: automatic fallback to next-region compatible GPUs unless tenant forbids cross-region. SLA credits apply if we miss committed uptime; we'll draft a short FAQ for sales/ops.
Nora: Can Console emit a webhook when regional capacity drops below threshold? SREs want to automate route shifting.
console-bot: Roadmap item created: region_capacity_webhook (beta end of Q2). We'll add green/yellow/red badges + webhook events.
Sam: Any plan to show per-model expected latency delta when switching variants? That will help app-level routing.
Vik: Yes, runtime will record sample delta stats and Console will surface a p95 delta per model-variant when fallbacks occur. ETA: next sprint.
Nora: Action items: 1) Publish blackout windows + per-region ETA (Ethan). 2) Post hot-pool/autoscaler docs + example configs (Vik). 3) Draft Dedicated failover/SLA FAQ (Billing/Ops). 4) Console: webhook + badge prototype (Console). I'll pin and follow up in #eng-infra.
Nora: Thanks all :thumbsup: closing thread unless someone needs deep dive.
